text:
Maya: Heads-up — kv-cache alert storm at 03:40 UTC, 3 pages in 15m. Filing follow-up. Incident: https://incidents.redwood/9881
Dan: saw the pages, looked like a tight burst pattern. existing dedupe missed it.
Kevin: can you dump the alert rule? likely eval window too short.
Maya: rule snippet below:
```
alert: kvcache_high_errors
expr: sum(rate(kv_cache_errors_total[1m])) by (shard) > 50
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/kvcache
```
Sophia: two quick fixes: increase the eval window to 5m, and dedupe using deployment+shard instead of shard alone. also consider turning transient bursts into tickets.
Nate: add suppression: if identical stack trace or metric identity fires >3x in 6m, consolidate to one page and mute further pages for 10m, escalate only on sustained increase.
Tara: I can own the rule update and add a 5m per-shard graph in dashboards. can push a staging PR today, ETA ~2h.
Maya: assign Tara for the change, Kevin for review, Maya for validation. timeline: PR today, staging test tonight, prod roll tomorrow morning unless staging fails.
Kevin: will review within 3h. also suggest making severity configurable in rule so we can switch to ticket during canary.
Sophia: reminder: kv-cache tends to spike after weekly infra deploys (seen 3x in past 3 months). should we add a lightweight post-deploy smoke check for cache error rate?
Maya: good idea. Nate and I can draft a smoke test. target for next sprint.
Tara: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra-alerts/pulls/453 — changes: eval window 5m, dedupe labels include deployment, added suppression logic and severity toggle. includes unit tests. CI green. PTAL @Kevin @Maya
Kevin: reviewing now. small nit on label naming, but overall LGTM.
IncidentBot: alert kvcache_high_errors triggered 2026-03-01T03:40:12Z -> pages:3, resolved 2026-03-01T03:55:02Z, incident: https://incidents.redwood/9881
Dan: also want a telemetry metric to measure "pages avoided by dedupe" so we can track noise reduction. can take this one next week.
Maya: post-deploy checklist: merge PR, monitor staging 6h, gradual prod rollout 10/30/60, update runbook with paging exceptions, add dedupe telemetry.
Tara: merged and rolled to staging. monitoring.
Maya: staging 90m looks clean, no extra pages. starting prod rollout per plan.
Dan: prod at 60% no pages so far.
Tara: prod at 100% 08:35, still clean. will keep dashboard pinned for 7 days and report back.
Nate: ops ticket created: https://issues.redwood/ops/3229 — smoke test story added, ETA sprint-end.
Sophia: proposed paging policy (for runbook): if alert resolves <10m -> ticket only; if sustained >10m -> page; immediate page for explicit high-severity signals; exceptions recorded in runbook.
Maya: Action items recap:
- Tara: implement rule + dashboard (done)
- Kevin: PR review (done)
- Maya: post-deploy validation & runbook update (tomorrow morning)
- Nate: create ops ticket for deploy smoke test (done)
- Dan: add dedupe telemetry metric (next week)
- Sophia: draft paging policy wording (next week)
Sophia: schedule a short follow-up in next oncall meeting to check if noise dropped after 7 days. :thumbsup:
Maya: updating the postmortem with owners & timelines now. ping here if anything else crops up. :white_check_mark:
